channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2020-10987 — Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute system commands via the deviceName POST parameter.

item.title: CVE-2021-31755 — Tenda AC11 Router
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Tenda AC11 devices contain a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in /goform/setmac which allows attackers to execute code via a crafted post request.

item.title: CVE-2021-27561 — Yealink Device Management
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Yealink Device Management contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-10189 — Zoho ManageEngine
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central contains a file upload vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2018-20062 — ThinkPHP noneCms
item.description: Threat Signal 80. ThinkPHP "noneCms" contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution through crafted use of the filter parameter.

item.title: CVE-2019-16759 — vBulletin vBulletin
item.description: Threat Signal 80. The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via the widgetConfig[code] parameter in an ajax/render/widget_php routestring request.

item.title: CVE-2017-9248 — Progress ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity have a cryptographic weakness in Telerik.Web.UI.dll that can be exploited to disclose encryption keys (Telerik.Web.UI.DialogParametersEncryptionKey and/or the MachineKey), perform cross-site-scripting (XSS) attacks, compromise the ASP.NET ViewState, and/or upload and download files.

item.title: CVE-2020-5847 — Unraid Unraid
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Unraid contains a vulnerability due to the insecure use of the extract PHP function that can be abused to execute remote code as root. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5849 for initial access.

item.title: CVE-2020-25213 — WordPress File Manager Plugin
item.description: Threat Signal 79. WordPress File Manager plugin contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to execute PHP code and upload malicious files on a target site.

item.title: CVE-2021-20016 — SonicWall SSLVPN SMA100
item.description: Threat Signal 78. SonicWall SSLVPN SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows remote exploitation for credential access by an unauthenticated attacker.

item.title: CVE-2020-12271 — Sophos SFOS
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Sophos Firewall operating system (SFOS) firmware contains a SQL injection vulnerability when configured with either the administration (HTTPS) service or the User Portal is exposed on the WAN zone. Successful exploitation may cause remote code execution to exfiltrate usernames and hashed passwords for the local device admin(s), portal admins, and user accounts used for remote access (but not external Active Directory or LDAP passwords).

item.title: CVE-2020-17496 — vBulletin vBulletin
item.description: Threat Signal 78. The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via crafted subWidgets data in an ajax/render/widget_tabbedcontainer_tab_panel request. This CVE ID resolves an incomplete patch for CVE-2019-16759.

item.title: CVE-2020-3952 — VMware vCenter Server
item.description: Threat Signal 78. VMware vCenter Server contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service (vmdir) when the Platform Services Controller (PSC) does not correctly implement access controls. Successful exploitation allows an attacker with network access to port 389 to extract sensitive information.

item.title: CVE-2020-29583 — Zyxel Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Zyxel firewalls (ATP, USG, VM) and AP Controllers (NXC2500 and NXC5500) contain a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability in an undocumented account ("zyfwp") with an unchangeable password.

item.title: CVE-2019-9082 — ThinkPHP ThinkPHP
item.description: Threat Signal 77. ThinkPHP contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via public//?s=index/\think\app/invokefunction&function=call_user_func_array&vars[0]=system&vars[1][]= followed by the command.

item.title: CVE-2020-3992 — VMware ESXi
item.description: Threat Signal 87. VMware ESXi OpenSLP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an attacker residing in the management network with access to port 427 to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-5544 — VMware VMware ESXi and Horizon DaaS
item.description: Threat Signal 89. VMware ESXi and Horizon Desktop as a Service (DaaS) OpenSLP contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to port 427 to overwrite the heap of the OpenSLP service to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-22005 — VMware vCenter Server
item.description: Threat Signal 90. VMware vCenter Server contains a file upload vulnerability in the Analytics service that allows a user with network access to port 443 to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2021-21972 — VMware vCenter Server
item.description: Threat Signal 90. VMware vCenter Server vSphere Client contains a remote code execution vulnerability in a vCenter Server plugin which allows an attacker with network access to port 443 to execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

item.title: CVE-2021-21985 — VMware vCenter Server
item.description: Threat Signal 90. VMware vSphere Client contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Virtual SAN Health Check plug-in, which is enabled by default in vCenter Server, which allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-40539 — Zoho ManageEngine
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus contains an authentication bypass vulnerability affecting the REST API URLs which allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-20085 — TVT NVMS-1000
item.description: Threat Signal 74. TVT devices utilizing NVMS-1000 software contain a directory traversal vulnerability via GET /.. requests.

item.title: CVE-2020-5849 — Unraid Unraid
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Unraid contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to gain access to the administrative interface. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5847 for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-11738 — WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator Plugin
item.description: Threat Signal 75. WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator plugin contains a file download vulnerability when an administrator creates a new copy of their site that allows an attacker to download the generated files from their Wordpress dashboard. This vulnerability affects Duplicator and Dulplicator Pro.

item.title: CVE-2019-7481 — SonicWall SMA100
item.description: Threat Signal 85. SonicWall SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to gain read-only access to unauthorized resources.

item.title: CVE-2021-20022 — SonicWall SonicWall Email Security
item.description: Threat Signal 67. SonicWall Email Security contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows a post-authenticated attacker to upload a file to the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20021 and CVE-2021-20023 to achieve privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2019-9978 — WordPress Social Warfare Plugin
item.description: Threat Signal 67. WordPress Social Warfare plugin contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability affects Social Warfare and Social Warfare Pro.

item.title: CVE-2019-8394 — Zoho ManageEngine
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote users to upload files via login page customization.

item.title: CVE-2017-6327 — Symantec Symantec Messaging Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Symantec Messaging Gateway contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution. With the ability to perform remote code execution, an attacker may also desire to perform privilege escalating actions.

item.title: CVE-2020-10181 — Sumavision Enhanced Multimedia Router (EMR)
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Sumavision Enhanced Multimedia Router (EMR) contains a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability allowing the creation of users with elevated privileges as administrator on a device.

item.title: CVE-2020-8599 — Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan
item.description: Threat Signal 62. Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan server contain a vulnerable EXE file that could allow a remote attacker to write data to a path on affected installations and bypass root login.

item.title: CVE-2021-20023 — SonicWall SonicWall Email Security
item.description: Threat Signal 70. SonicWall Email Security contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows a post-authenticated attacker to read files on the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20021 and CVE-2021-20022 to achieve privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2018-14558 — Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 62. Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 devices contain a command injection vulnerability due to the "formsetUsbUnload" function executes a dosystemCmd function with untrusted input. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute OS commands via a crafted goform/setUsbUnload request.

item.title: CVE-2020-4006 — VMware Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 61. VMware Workspace One Access, Access Connector, Identity Manager, and Identity Manager Connector contain a command injection vulnerability. An attacker with network access to the administrative configurator on port 8443 and a valid password for the configurator administrator account can execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

item.title: CVE-2020-8467 — Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan contain an unspecified vulnerability within a migration tool component that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-18187 — Trend Micro OfficeScan
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Trend Micro OfficeScan contains a directory traversal vulnerability by extracting files from a zip file to a specific folder on the OfficeScan server, leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-36741 — Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security contain an improper input validation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to upload files.

item.title: CVE-2020-8468 — Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan and Worry-Free Business Security Agents
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security agents contain a content validation escape vulnerability that could allow an attacker to manipulate certain agent client components.

item.title: CVE-2020-3950 — VMware Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 57. VMware Fusion, Remote Console (VMRC) for Mac, and Horizon Client for Mac contain a privilege escalation vulnerability due to improper use of setuid binaries that allows attackers to escalate privileges to root.

item.title: CVE-2020-24557 — Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security
item.description: Threat Signal 57. Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security on Microsoft Windows contain an improper access control vulnerability that may allow an attacker to manipulate a particular product folder to disable the security temporarily, abuse a specific Windows function, and attain privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2021-36742 — Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security contain an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2019-18988 — TeamViewer Desktop
item.description: Threat Signal 55. TeamViewer Desktop allows for bypass of remote-login access control because the same AES key is used for different customers' installations. If an attacker were to know this key, they could decrypt protected information stored in registry or configuration files or decryption of the Unattended Access password to the system (which allows for remote login to the system).

item.title: CVE-2026-81963 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Microsoft Windows Update Stack contains a link following vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges locally up to SYSTEM.

item.title: CVE-2026-85880 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2024-58136 — Yiiframework Yii
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Yii Framework contains an improper protection of alternate path vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. This vulnerability could affect other products that implement Yii, including—but not limited to—Craft CMS, as represented by CVE-2025-32432.

item.title: CVE-2026-82078 — PaperCut NG/MF
item.description: Threat Signal 66. PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.

item.title: CVE-2025-20337 — Cisco Identity Services Engine
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Cisco Identity Services Engine contains an injection vulnerability in a specific API of Cisco ISE and Cisco ISE-PIC due to insufficient validation of user-supplied input allowing an attacker to exploit this vulnerability by submitting a crafted API request. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to perform remote code execution and obtaining root privileges on an affected device.

item.title: CVE-2026-84869 — ConnectWise ScreenConnect
item.description: Threat Signal 70. ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to file transfer and execution through an active remote sessions without authorization or host confirmation.

item.title: CVE-2026-81578 — PaperCut NG/MF
item.description: Threat Signal 65. PaperCut NG/MF contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify certain system configurations. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-82078.
